context: Riku tells Aoi about a ski trip.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (スキー/観客/体力/クリア/ライト) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 冬休み、スキーに行ってきたよ!
lines.en: I went skiing over winter break!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、スキーは体力使うでしょ?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、体力がかなり要ったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, it took quite a lot of stamina.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 難しいコースは、クリアできた?
lines.en: Did you clear the hard courses?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 上級コースを、クリアしたんだ!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夜は、ライトアップされてた?
lines.en: Were the slopes lit up at night?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ライトに照らされて、きれいだったよ。
lines.en: Lit up by the lights, it was beautiful.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 観客みたいに、私も見たかったな!
lines.en: I wanted to watch like a spectator too!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
